title: Talented artist Vidpoet releases his recent single “Unfinished Sculpture, Pt. 1”
htmlContent:
Kicking off the fall with a bang, talented artist, Vidpoet has once again proven to all his audience how talented he is in making his music. The American musical genius, Vidpoet recently unleashed his debut single, “Unfinished Sculpture, Pt. 1”.

Vidpoet’s “Unfinished Sculpture, Pt. 1” is music that represents artistry to the fullest and lives up to the name with an unmistakable sound that inspires like no there. Every facet of the piece is done to a superb level to make one sonically fantastic sound, as he brings the story to life in an authentic way on this masterpiece that doesn’t miss.
